# assignmentB2MingyangFan

The goal of assignmentB2MingyangFan is to provide a function that counts the number of missing values for all columns in each group of a dataset. This package gives users the opportunity to identify and compare these missing values.

## Installation

Package installation can be done directly by calling

`devtools::install_github("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2MingyangFan", ref = "0.1.0")`


## Example

This is an example using the built-in airquality dataset to count the missing values in each column for each month:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2MingyangFan)

count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```
